cards.speaker: James
cards.text: I want us the leading seller of {calc} in London, at 35% or better. We're on {share}%, and {rival} is the one to pass. The Guild's standard for a leading house is the biggest share of an ore. Meeting it is the least I'll accept.

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: Take first place on {calc}, at a 35% share. You hold {share}% and {rival} is ahead. A house that leads its ore is one the Guild has to deal with as an equal. Then they can't say we're beneath them.

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: Be the largest seller of {calc}, with 35% or more. You're at {share}%, and {rival} is the name above yours. First place is how the Guild measures a house. I'd like the measure to come out in our favour for once.

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: First place on {calc}, 35% at least. Your share is {share}% and {rival} stands in the way. The Guild counts a house that leads its ore as a real one. Sell more {calc} than anyone and it has to count us.
